title: Where the wind blows: the world's winds, and are wind farms in the windy places?
excerpt: I mapped the world's winds month by month, from the trade winds to the Roaring Forties and the monsoon, and set 5,344 wind farms against the wind at their sites. 82% of onshore capacity stands on ground windier than its country's median.
seo_description: A month by month map of the world's winds, the windiest places on land, the UK at 9 km, and whether wind farms stand where the wind blows.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Where the wind blows' in navy on pale paper, with a line saying 82% of onshore wind farm capacity sits on ground windier than its country's median. Below, a world map of mean wind speed: pale green land in the tropics, deeper blue over windy plains and coasts, faded pink and violet oceans crossed by dark streamlines of the trade winds and the westerlies racing round the Southern Ocean.
